EN-WR-F00-Q01.text: Read the sentence on the card and find the gap. Type the missing word.

EN-WR-F00-Q02.text: There's a word missing from the sentence on the card. Type the word that fits.

EN-WR-F00-Q03.text: Look at the picture and listen to the word. Then type it.

EN-WR-F00-Q04.text: Listen to the word, then put the letters in order to spell it.

EN-WR-F00-Q05.text: Listen to the sentence, then drag the words into the same order.

EN-WR-F00-Q06.text: Look at the picture and the word next to it. What letter does the word start with? Type it.

EN-WR-F00-Q07.text: Look at the word on the card and type it exactly as you see it.

EN-WR-F00-Q08.text: Listen to the word, then look at the gap. Type the missing letter.

EN-WR-T01-Q01.text: Look at the picture and listen to the word. Then type it, letter by letter.

EN-WR-T01-Q02.text: Here's a picture, and you'll hear its name. Can you type the word yourself?

EN-WR-T01-Q03.text: Look at the picture, listen, and then type the word you hear.

EN-WR-T01-Q04.text: Think about each sound in the word you hear. Then type the letters that make those sounds.

EN-WR-T01-Q05.text: Have a look at the picture and listen carefully. Then type the word.

EN-WR-T01-Q06.text: Picture, then sound, then spelling. Listen to the word and type it.

EN-WR-T01-Q07.text: Say the word for this picture slowly to yourself after you hear it. Then type it.

EN-WR-T01-Q08.text: Listen to the word, look at the picture, then type it as carefully as you can.

EN-WR-T01-Q09.text: Can you type the word that goes with this picture? Listen first, then take it one sound at a time.

EN-WR-T01-Q10.text: Here's a picture with a word to catch. Listen, then type the word you hear.

EN-WR-T02-Q01.text: Use the letter tiles to spell the word. Drag them into place one at a time.

EN-WR-T02-Q02.text: Think about each sound in the word, then drag the letters that make those sounds into order.

EN-WR-T02-Q03.text: Spell the word with the letter tiles. Drag each letter into its spot.

EN-WR-T02-Q04.text: Take your time. Drag the letters into the right order to spell the word.

EN-WR-T02-Q05.text: Say the word slowly in your head. Then drag the letters to spell it, sound by sound.

EN-WR-T02-Q06.text: Build the word with the tiles. Drag the letters into order to spell it.

EN-WR-T02-Q07.text: One by one, drag the letters in to spell the word.

EN-WR-T02-Q08.text: Which letters make each sound in the word? Drag them into order to spell it.

EN-WR-T02-Q09.text: Letter building time. Drag the tiles into place to spell the word.

EN-WR-T02-Q10.text: The letters are all jumbled up. Drag them into the right order to spell the word.

EN-WR-T03-Q01.text: A letter is missing from this word. Look at the gap and type the letter that fills it.

EN-WR-T03-Q02.text: Look at the word with a gap in it. Which letter is missing? Type it.

EN-WR-T03-Q03.text: Say the word in your head and listen for the missing sound. Type the letter that goes in the gap.

EN-WR-T03-Q04.text: There's a gap in the word on the card. Type the letter that completes it.

EN-WR-T03-Q05.text: One letter has gone missing from this word. Look closely, then type the letter that belongs there.

EN-WR-T03-Q06.text: Fill the gap. Think about the sound that's missing, then type its letter.

EN-WR-T03-Q07.text: Read the letters you can see, then type the one that fills the gap.

EN-WR-T03-Q08.text: Find the gap in the word. What sound belongs there? Type the letter for it.

EN-WR-T03-Q09.text: Uh oh, a letter has escaped from this word. Type it back into the gap.

EN-WR-T03-Q10.text: This word is missing a letter. Can you type the letter that fits in the gap?

EN-WR-T04-Q01.text: Listen to the word, then type it. You can say it quietly to yourself first.

EN-WR-T04-Q02.text: Here's a spelling to try. Listen to the word and type it.

EN-WR-T04-Q03.text: Type the word you hear, one letter at a time. Listen carefully first.

EN-WR-T04-Q04.text: Listen for each sound in the word. Then type the letters that make those sounds.

EN-WR-T04-Q05.text: When you've heard the word, type what you heard.

EN-WR-T04-Q06.text: Listen, think, type. Spell the word you hear as carefully as you can.

EN-WR-T04-Q07.text: Break the word into sounds in your head as you listen. Then type it.

EN-WR-T04-Q08.text: Listen closely to this word. Then type it the way you think it's spelled.

EN-WR-T04-Q09.text: Ears ready? Listen to the word, then type it in.

EN-WR-T04-Q10.text: A word is coming your way. Listen, then type it. Take it one sound at a time.

EN-WR-T05-Q01.text: Put the word tiles in order to build a sentence. Read it back when you're done.

EN-WR-T05-Q02.text: Drag each word tile into place so they make one sensible sentence.

EN-WR-T05-Q03.text: Build a sentence from these words. Drag them into an order that sounds right when you read it.

EN-WR-T05-Q04.text: Put the words in order to make a sentence. Read it to yourself to check it makes sense.

EN-WR-T05-Q05.text: Drag the words around until they make a sentence. Then read it back to check.

EN-WR-T05-Q06.text: These words are in a jumble. Drag them into order to build a sentence.

EN-WR-T05-Q07.text: These words are mixed up. Drag them into an order that makes a proper sentence.

EN-WR-T05-Q08.text: Arrange these word tiles into a sentence. Read it back once you're done.

EN-WR-T05-Q09.text: Drag these words into order. Can you build a sentence that makes sense?

EN-WR-T05-Q10.text: These words need sorting out. Drag them into order so they make a sentence.

EN-WR-T06-Q01.text: Look at the picture clue. Then use the word tiles to build a sentence about it.

EN-WR-T06-Q02.text: Use the picture clue and the word tiles. Drag words into order to build a sentence that fits.

EN-WR-T06-Q03.text: Check your clue picture, then build a sentence from these word tiles. Read it back once it's done.

EN-WR-T06-Q04.text: Use the word tiles to build a sentence that matches the clue. Read it back when you're done.

EN-WR-T06-Q05.text: What does the clue show? Build a sentence about it using the word tiles.

EN-WR-T06-Q06.text: Build a sentence from the word tiles that fits the clue. Think about who did what.

EN-WR-T06-Q07.text: Look at the clue, then drag the word tiles into a sentence that matches it.

EN-WR-T06-Q08.text: Read the clue and the word tiles. Build a sentence that fits, one word at a time.

EN-WR-T06-Q09.text: Here's a clue picture and some word tiles. Can you build a sentence about it?

EN-WR-T06-Q10.text: Look at your clue, then build a sentence from these word tiles. Drag them in one by one.

EN-WR-T07-Q01.text: This sentence needs fixing. Type it out again with a capital letter and a full stop where they belong.

EN-WR-T07-Q02.text: Check the sentence on the card. What's missing at the start and at the end? Type it out correctly.

EN-WR-T07-Q03.text: Be the editor. Type the sentence again, adding the capital letter and full stop it needs.

EN-WR-T07-Q04.text: Read the sentence, then type it again with the right capital letter and full stop.

EN-WR-T07-Q05.text: Look closely at this sentence. Think about where capitals belong, then type it out with a full stop too.

EN-WR-T07-Q06.text: Spot what's missing in this sentence, then type it again so it's correct.

EN-WR-T07-Q07.text: This sentence has lost its capital letter and its full stop. Type it again with both added.

EN-WR-T07-Q08.text: Check every word in the sentence. Which ones need a capital? Type the fixed sentence with a full stop.

EN-WR-T07-Q09.text: Oops, this sentence forgot its capital letters and full stop. Can you type it out the right way?

EN-WR-T07-Q10.text: Fix-it time. Type the sentence again with a capital letter at the start and a full stop at the end.

EN-WR-T08-Q01.text: Look at the word and the ending on the card. Join them together and type the new word.

EN-WR-T08-Q02.text: Add the ending to the word on the card. Think about how the new word is spelled, then type it.

EN-WR-T08-Q03.text: Put the word and its ending together. Type the new word you make.

EN-WR-T08-Q04.text: Read the word and the ending. Then type the word with its new ending added.

EN-WR-T08-Q05.text: Join the word and the ending, then type the new word. Check your spelling before you finish.

EN-WR-T08-Q06.text: Make a new word by adding the ending. Type it in.

EN-WR-T08-Q07.text: Read the card, add the ending to the word, and type what you get.

EN-WR-T08-Q08.text: Join the word and the ending together. Say the new word to yourself, then type it.

EN-WR-T08-Q09.text: Word builder time. Stick the ending onto the word and type the new word you made.

EN-WR-T08-Q10.text: This word wants a new ending. Add it on, then type the new word.

EN-WR-T09-Q01.text: Read the word and the change on the card. Swap the letter and type the new word.

EN-WR-T09-Q02.text: Follow the instruction on the card. Change the letter it tells you to, then type the new word.

EN-WR-T09-Q03.text: Swap one letter as the card shows, and a new word appears. Type it.

EN-WR-T09-Q04.text: Look at the word and the letter to change. Make the swap, then type your new word.

EN-WR-T09-Q05.text: Read the card carefully. Replace the letter it names, then type the word you've made.

EN-WR-T09-Q06.text: Make the letter swap shown on the card and type the new word you get.

EN-WR-T09-Q07.text: Follow the card to swap the letters, then type the new word.

EN-WR-T09-Q08.text: Which letters does the card ask you to swap? Make the change, then type the new word.

EN-WR-T09-Q09.text: Magic letter swap. Change the letter the card shows and type the new word.

EN-WR-T09-Q10.text: Swap the letters as the card shows, and you'll have a brand new word. Type it in.

EN-WR-T10-Q01.text: Read the word on the card and think of its opposite. Type that word.

EN-WR-T10-Q02.text: What's the opposite of the word on the card? Think it through, then type it.

EN-WR-T10-Q03.text: Read the word on the card. Now flip it. Type a word that means the opposite.

EN-WR-T10-Q04.text: Look at the word on the card. Type a word with the opposite meaning.

EN-WR-T10-Q05.text: Which word says the opposite of the one on the card? Think, then type it.

EN-WR-T10-Q06.text: Think of the opposite of the word on the card, then type it.

EN-WR-T10-Q07.text: Read the word, then type a word that means its opposite.

EN-WR-T10-Q08.text: Opposites puzzle. Read the card, work out the opposite word, and type your answer.

EN-WR-T10-Q09.text: Can you think of another word that means the same as the one on the card? Type it.

EN-WR-T10-Q10.text: Read the word on the card, then type a different word that means the same thing.

EN-WR-T11-Q01.text: Look at the pictures on the card. Write a short sentence that says what's happening.

EN-WR-T11-Q02.text: Study the pictures and work out what they show together. Then write a short caption.

EN-WR-T11-Q03.text: Write a caption for these pictures in one short sentence. Remember your capital letter and full stop.

EN-WR-T11-Q04.text: What do the pictures show? Write a short sentence to go with them.

EN-WR-T11-Q05.text: Use the picture clues. Write one short sentence that describes what's going on.

EN-WR-T11-Q06.text: Put these pictures into words. Write a short caption that fits them.

EN-WR-T11-Q07.text: Think about what the pictures mean together, then write a short caption.

EN-WR-T11-Q08.text: These pictures tell a tiny story. Write a short sentence that captures it.

EN-WR-T11-Q09.text: Look at the pictures. What's happening? Write a short caption about them.

EN-WR-T11-Q10.text: Imagine what happened in these pictures. Write a short caption to go with them.

EN-WR-T12-Q01.text: Read the sentence on the card and find the gap. Type the word that fills it.

EN-WR-T12-Q02.text: There's a word missing from this sentence. Read it carefully and type the word that fits.

EN-WR-T12-Q03.text: Think about what makes sense in the gap as you read the sentence. Type your word.

EN-WR-T12-Q04.text: Which word belongs in the gap? Read the sentence, then type it.

EN-WR-T12-Q05.text: Read the sentence and work out what's missing. Then type what fits the gap.

EN-WR-T12-Q06.text: Fill the gap. Read the whole sentence, then type the missing word.

EN-WR-T12-Q07.text: Spot the gap in the sentence. Type a word that fits.

EN-WR-T12-Q08.text: What word makes this sentence complete? Read it carefully, then type it.

EN-WR-T12-Q09.text: A word is missing from this sentence. What do you think goes there? Type it.

EN-WR-T12-Q10.text: Fill the gap in the sentence on the card with a word that fits. Type it in.

EN-WR-T13-Q01.text: One word in this sentence is spelled wrong. Find it, then type it the right way.

EN-WR-T13-Q02.text: Spelling detective time. Read the sentence, spot the word that's spelled wrong, and type it correctly.

EN-WR-T13-Q03.text: Which word looks wrong? Read the sentence slowly, then type its correct spelling.

EN-WR-T13-Q04.text: Read each word in the sentence. When you find the misspelled one, type it correctly.

EN-WR-T13-Q05.text: A spelling mistake is hiding in this sentence. Find it and type the word the right way.

EN-WR-T13-Q06.text: Check every word in the sentence. One is misspelled. Type the correct spelling.

EN-WR-T13-Q07.text: Find the word with a spelling mistake in this sentence, and type it correctly.

EN-WR-T13-Q08.text: Look closely at each word. Which one isn't spelled right? Type it the correct way.

EN-WR-T13-Q09.text: Oops, a word in this sentence got its spelling mixed up. Can you find it and type it the right way?

EN-WR-T13-Q10.text: Hunt for the misspelled word in this sentence. When you find it, type it correctly.

EN-WR-T14-Q01.text: Think about washing your hands before you eat. Why do we do it? Write a short answer in your own words.

EN-WR-T14-Q02.text: Here's a why question about wearing a helmet on a bike. Think about the reason, then write a short answer.

EN-WR-T14-Q03.text: Before crossing a road, we look both ways. Why? Write a short answer that explains the reason.

EN-WR-T14-Q04.text: Think about Tia telling her mum the truth. Why did she feel better afterwards? Write a short answer.

EN-WR-T14-Q05.text: Saving a little money each week: why is that a good idea? Think it through, then write a short answer.

EN-WR-T14-Q06.text: Think about the lonely boy who smiled when Ben asked him to play. Why did he smile? Write your answer.

EN-WR-T14-Q07.text: When the fire alarm rang, Nina walked instead of running. Why do you think that was? Write a short answer.

EN-WR-T14-Q08.text: Omar took three slow breaths when he felt cross. Why do you think he did that? Write a short answer.

EN-WR-T14-Q09.text: Picture a duck sitting on Dad's hat and refusing to move. Why do you think it stayed? Write a short answer.

EN-WR-T14-Q10.text: The turtle won the race. Why do you think that happened? Write your idea in a short answer.

EN-WR-T15-Q01.text: Think about what you do before you go to sleep. Write two sentences about getting ready for bed.

EN-WR-T15-Q02.text: How do you keep yourself clean? Write two sentences about it.

EN-WR-T15-Q03.text: Write two sentences about staying safe when you ride a bike. Think about what you do before and during a ride.

EN-WR-T15-Q04.text: Think of a time you helped someone. Write two or three sentences about what happened.

EN-WR-T15-Q05.text: How do you save money? Write two or three sentences about the way you do it.

EN-WR-T15-Q06.text: Think about a time you felt cross. Write two or three sentences about what you do when that happens.

EN-WR-T15-Q07.text: Think of a time when telling the truth was hard, but you did it anyway. Write two or three sentences about it.

EN-WR-T15-Q08.text: How do you cross a road safely? Write two or three sentences explaining what you do.

EN-WR-T15-Q09.text: Imagine a duck wearing a hat. Write two or three silly sentences about it.

EN-WR-T15-Q10.text: Imagine a superhero who loves vegetables. Write two or three sentences about them.
